description: A portable review with an embedded book reference.

main.description: A review or rating of a book. Separate record keys allow multiple reviews of the same book, including rereads.

record.description: A self-contained review. At least one of rating or nonempty textContent is required.

rating.description: Rating on a 1-20 scale; divide by four for a five-star display.

textContent.description: Plain-text review, without Markdown. At least one of rating or nonempty textContent must be supplied. Rich content alone does not satisfy this requirement.

subjectRecord.description: Optional AT-URI to an edition record for enrichment; subject.identifiers remain the matching mechanism.

content.description: Optional client-specific rich content, using the same open-union shape as site.standard.document.content. Each content object must include a $type identifying its format. A written review must also supply its plain-text textContent fallback.
